title: How to Count AIs: Individuation and Liability for AI Agents
affiliations: University of Alabama - School of Law, The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong and University of Houston Law Center

detail.title: How to Count AIs: Individuation and Liability for AI Agents
detail.abstract:
Very soon, millions of AI agents will proliferate across the economy, autonomously taking billions of actions. Inevitably, things will go wrong. Humans will be defrauded, injured, even killed. Law will somehow have to  govern the coming wave. But when an AI causes harm, the first question to answer before anyone can be held accountable is: Which AI Did It?

Identifying AIs is unusually difficult. AIs lack bodies. They can copy, split, merge, and swarm at will. Even today, a “single” AI agent is often an ensemble of instances based on multiple models. The complexity will only multiply as AI capabilities improve.

This Article is the first to comprehensively diagnose the legal problem of identifying AIs. For AI agents to be effectively governed, the Article argues, two kinds of identity are required: “thin” and “thick.” Thin identification is the project of tying every action taken by an AI to some human principal. Thin identity will be essential for law to hold accountable the humans who make and use AI agents. Thick identification is the project of distinguishing between AI agents, qua agents. It requires sorting millions of AI entities into discrete, persistent units with stable, coherent goals. Thick identity is essential for governing AIs’ behavior directly in the many contexts where principal–agent problems prevent humans from perfectly controlling AIs.

The Article is also the first to present a solution to the twin identity problem. We call it the “Algorithmic Corporation” or “A-corp,” a legal-fictional entity that can hold property, make contracts, and litigate in its own name. An A-corp is owned by humans. But it is designed to be run by AIs. The A-corp solves the thin identity problem by tying AI actions to a human owner. And it solves the thick identity problem via emergent self-organization. A-corps will own the resources which AIs need to accomplish their goals. AIs that control A-corps will thus have strong incentives to share control only with other AIs that share their goals. In equilibrium, both incentive and selection mechanisms will force A-corps to self-organize into persistent, legally legible entities with coherent underlying goals. These coherent, agentic entities will respond rationally to legal incentives, like liability.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面诊断AI身份识别的法律问题，提出AI治理需要"薄身份"和"厚身份"双重识别，并引入"算法公司"作为解决方案，通过法律虚构实体解决AI责任归属问题。
AI.research_question: 当AI造成伤害时，如何识别责任主体？法律如何有效治理即将涌现的数百万AI代理？
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理在经济中大规模部署并自主采取行动，不可避免地会发生伤害事件。然而AI缺乏实体形态、可复制、分裂、合并和集群的特性使得身份识别异常困难，现有法律框架无法有效应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 薄身份识别理论：将AI行为追溯到人类主体；2) 厚身份识别理论：区分AI代理作为独立实体；3) 委托-代理问题理论；4) 法律虚构实体理论
AI.method: 法律分析和理论构建方法，通过概念分析诊断AI身份识别问题，提出"算法公司"作为制度解决方案，并分析其激励机制和均衡状态。
AI.findings: 1) AI身份识别需要双重机制：薄身份（追溯人类责任）和厚身份（区分AI实体）；2) 算法公司能够同时解决这两个问题；3) 通过资源所有权和激励机制，算法公司会自我组织成具有稳定目标的持久实体。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统提出AI身份识别的法律理论框架；2) 区分薄身份和厚身份概念；3) 引入算法公司作为法律虚构实体；4) 为AI治理提供新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为立法者提供具体的制度设计方案；2) 解决AI责任归属的实际法律问题；3) 为AI产业发展提供可预测的法律环境；4) 通过激励机制设计促进AI自我组织。

title: Medication Error Involving Insulin: A Medico-Legal Reflection

detail.title: Medication Error Involving Insulin: A Medico-Legal Reflection

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships with people or organizations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Medicine is considered a noble profession, and doctors are highly respected for their expertise in saving lives. The standard of care assumes that practioners possess both the technical skills and the diagnostic vigilance required for their role. Errors can occur due to negligence, which is influenced by various factors. Medication errors are still a major cause of preventable harm. This paper consists of two cases that I encountered during my clinical exposure, which involve insulin related prescription discharge errors. The causes are analysed using the medico legal approach, which illustrates the relationship between clinical error, pharmacological causes, system failure, and legal responsibility. This highlights how breakdown during transition care, especially during discharge, can lead to serious harm to the patient and legal consequences. This analysis shows the importance of documentation, cross-checking, professional responsibility, and legal awareness in clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过两个胰岛素相关处方出院错误案例，分析了医疗差错、药理学原因、系统故障和法律责任的相互关系，强调过渡期护理中文件记录、交叉核对、专业责任和法律意识的重要性。
AI.research_question: 胰岛素相关处方出院错误如何通过医学法律方法分析，揭示临床差错、药理学原因、系统故障和法律责任的相互关系？
AI.motivation: 药物错误仍然是可预防伤害的主要原因，特别是在过渡期护理（如出院）中，胰岛素相关处方错误可能导致严重患者伤害和法律后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医学法律方法，分析临床差错、药理学原因、系统故障和法律责任的相互关系框架。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，基于作者临床实践中遇到的两个胰岛素相关处方出院错误案例，采用医学法律方法进行分析。
AI.findings: 过渡期护理（特别是出院期间）的失误可能导致严重患者伤害；胰岛素处方错误涉及临床、药理学、系统等多方面因素；文件记录不完整、交叉核对缺失、专业责任意识不足是主要问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了临床差错、药理学原因、系统故障和法律责任的综合分析框架；提供了医学法律方法在医疗差错分析中的应用实例。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了文件记录、交叉核对、专业责任和法律意识在临床实践中的重要性；为医疗机构改进过渡期护理流程提供了具体建议；提高了对胰岛素相关处方错误风险的认识。

title: The Conduct of LTV Policy under Inflationary Shocks
affiliations: University of Nottingham and Bank of Ireland

detail.title: The Conduct of LTV Policy under Inflationary Shocks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 1, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines loan-to-value (LTV) policy as a macroprudential tool and its interactions with monetary policy in an inflationary environment. The combination of inflation shocks and collateral constraints introduces additional trade-offs for policymakers, emphasizing the need for coordination between macroprudential and monetary policies. Using a DSGE model with collateral constraints, we evaluate the implications of an optimized LTV rule for a welfare-based loss function that incorporates economic and financial stability. Our core finding indicates that, under inflation shocks, policy coordination reduces welfare-based losses compared to a non-coordination regime. In particular, the LTV rule is active (responding to cyclical factors, e.g. house prices) when monetary policy responds weakly to inflation shocks, but the LTV rule becomes passive (only responding to structural factors) when monetary policy chooses to be hawkish towards inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通胀环境下贷款价值比(LTV)政策作为宏观审慎工具及其与货币政策的互动。通胀冲击与抵押品约束的结合为政策制定者带来了额外权衡，强调宏观审慎与货币政策协调的必要性。使用带抵押品约束的DSGE模型评估优化LTV规则对包含经济和金融稳定的福利损失函数的影响。核心发现：通胀冲击下，政策协调相比非协调机制能减少福利损失。具体而言，当货币政策对通胀冲击反应较弱时，LTV规则是积极的（响应周期性因素如房价）；但当货币政策对通胀采取鹰派立场时，LTV规则变为被动的（仅响应结构性因素）。
AI.research_question: 在通胀环境下，贷款价值比(LTV)政策作为宏观审慎工具如何与货币政策互动？政策协调是否能够改善福利结果？
AI.motivation: 通胀冲击与抵押品约束的结合为政策制定者带来了额外的权衡考量，强调了宏观审慎政策与货币政策之间协调的必要性。在通胀环境下，传统的政策框架可能不足以同时应对经济稳定和金融稳定目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态随机一般均衡(DSGE)模型，包含抵押品约束，分析宏观审慎政策与货币政策的互动。理论框架强调通胀冲击下政策协调的重要性。
AI.method: 使用带抵押品约束的DSGE模型，评估优化LTV规则对福利损失函数的影响。福利损失函数同时包含经济稳定和金融稳定目标。
AI.findings: 核心发现表明，在通胀冲击下，政策协调相比非协调机制能减少福利损失。具体而言，当货币政策对通胀冲击反应较弱时，LTV规则是积极的（响应周期性因素如房价）；但当货币政策对通胀采取鹰派立场时，LTV规则变为被动的（仅响应结构性因素）。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上贡献于宏观审慎政策与货币政策协调的文献，特别是在通胀环境下。提出了LTV规则根据货币政策立场调整的机制，丰富了政策互动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在通胀环境下协调宏观审慎与货币政策的实用指导。具体建议：当货币政策对通胀反应较弱时，LTV规则应更积极地响应房价等周期性因素；当货币政策鹰派时，LTV规则可更被动，主要关注结构性因素。

title: Treasure Island: The Romantic Assassin
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Treasure Island: The Romantic Assassin
detail.abstract: The bull market in gold and silver appears romantic, yet it acts as an elegant assassin, silently strangling global liquidity. As of early 2026, the total market capitalization of above-ground precious metal stocks has approached nearly 30% of global GDP; the price appreciation alone has effectively locked away liquidity equivalent to nearly 20% of annual global output. A critical sentiment indicator-the "laggard signal"-is now flashing: my father and sister, the demographic least sensitive to economic shifts, have yet to enter the market. Their eventual entry suggests a potential for at least another 50% upside, marking the dangerous climax of this "safehaven" frenzy-one that threatens to push the world into a deeper abyss of stagnation. This paper provides no exhaustive formulas, only a logical derivation: from the emergence of "blood gold" driven by price surges to extreme physical hoarding and the self-reinforcing bubble of illusory industrial demand. The conclusion remains singular: the Romantic Assassin is draining global cash flow, leaving behind a world that can no longer turn.

AI.tldr: 黄金白银牛市看似浪漫，实则作为优雅刺客正在扼杀全球流动性。截至2026年初，地上贵金属总市值已接近全球GDP的30%，仅价格上涨就锁定了相当于全球年产出近20%的流动性。当最不敏感经济变化的"落后者"（作者父亲和姐姐）入场时，市场可能还有50%上涨空间，但这将是危险的顶峰，可能将世界推向更深的停滞深渊。
AI.research_question: 贵金属牛市如何通过价格飙升、实物囤积和虚幻工业需求形成自我强化的泡沫，并最终成为"浪漫刺客"扼杀全球流动性？
AI.motivation: 观察到贵金属市场市值已接近全球GDP的30%，价格上涨锁定了相当于全球年产出20%的流动性，这种"安全港"狂热可能将世界推向更深的经济停滞，需要分析其内在机制和潜在风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 市场泡沫理论：价格飙升驱动的自我强化机制；2. 流动性陷阱理论：资产价格锁定现金流的效应；3. 行为金融学：从众心理和"落后者信号"；4. 安全港资产悖论：避险资产反而制造系统性风险。
AI.method: 逻辑推导法而非详尽公式：从价格飙升驱动的"血金"现象，到极端实物囤积，再到虚幻工业需求形成的自我强化泡沫，通过逻辑链条分析贵金属牛市对全球流动性的影响机制。
AI.findings: 1. 贵金属牛市通过价格锁定机制有效锁定了相当于全球年产出20%的流动性；2. "落后者信号"显示市场仍有50%上涨潜力，但这是危险的顶峰；3. 从"血金"到实物囤积再到虚幻工业需求形成了自我强化的泡沫机制；4. 浪漫刺客正在耗尽全球现金流，可能导致世界陷入无法运转的停滞状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"浪漫刺客"概念，描述看似有益的资产类别如何成为系统性风险源；2. 建立"落后者信号"作为市场情绪极端化的新指标；3. 揭示安全港资产悖论：避险需求反而制造更大的系统性风险；4. 分析贵金属流动性锁定对全球经济的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供预警：贵金属市场可能成为新的系统性风险源；2. 为投资者提供风险识别框架：识别"落后者信号"等极端化指标；3. 为监管机构提供监测重点：关注贵金属流动性锁定效应；4. 为全球经济稳定提供新视角：需重新评估传统安全港资产的系统性影响。

title: Opaque Markets, Visible Jobs: Real-Time Labor Demand Disclosures and Municipal Finance
affiliations: Tulane University - A.B. Freeman School of Business, National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN) and University of Iowa - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Opaque Markets, Visible Jobs: Real-Time Labor Demand Disclosures and Municipal Finance
detail.abstract: We study the value relevance of real-time disclosures of local labor demand in the municipal bond secondary market. Using a near-universe of online job postings by all employers, we construct a monthly county-level hiring index that leads government-reported labor statistics. We document a negative association between the index and subsequent bond trading spreads. This association is driven primarily by lower values of the index, which suggests that weak labor demand leads to higher municipal financing costs. The main effect is stronger when local labor demand is more informative about future economic gains and when bondholders are more exposed to issuer credit fundamentals, but attenuated when investors face greater information processing costs and trading frictions. Overall, our evidence suggests that real-time labor demand disclosures enhance price discovery in opaque public debt markets by providing timely signals of local economic fundamentals.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了实时劳动力需求披露对市政债券二级市场的影响，发现地方劳动力需求指数与后续债券交易利差呈负相关，表明实时劳动力数据能增强不透明公共债务市场的价格发现功能。
AI.research_question: 实时披露的地方劳动力需求信息在市政债券二级市场中是否具有价值相关性？
AI.motivation: 市政债券市场相对不透明，投资者缺乏及时的地方经济基本面信息。实时劳动力需求数据可能提供比政府统计数据更及时的信号，影响债券定价和交易。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和市场效率理论，探讨实时信息披露对债券市场定价的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用近乎全样本的在线招聘数据构建县级月度招聘指数，该指数领先于政府报告的劳动力统计数据。分析指数与后续债券交易利差的关系，并进行异质性检验。
AI.findings: 劳动力需求指数与后续债券交易利差呈负相关，主要受指数较低值驱动（即劳动力需求疲软导致市政融资成本上升）。该效应在劳动力需求对未来经济收益更具信息性、债券持有人更暴露于发行人信用基本面时更强，但在投资者面临更高信息处理成本和交易摩擦时减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 为实时信息披露在公共债务市场中的价值相关性提供了实证证据，扩展了信息不对称理论在不透明债券市场中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明实时劳动力需求数据能增强市政债券市场的价格发现功能，为投资者、发行人和监管机构提供了及时的地方经济基本面信号。

title: A Tale of Two Inflations: Implications of Inflation Measurement for Indian Households and Business Decision-Making
affiliations: Amity International School, Saket

detail.title: A Tale of Two Inflations: Implications of Inflation Measurement for Indian Households and Business Decision-Making
detail.abstract: This paper examines the divergence between official inflation indicators and the inflation experiences reported by Indian households. While headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation figures have often remained within moderate ranges, households continue to experience sustained increases in the cost of essential goods and services. By conceptually comparing headline and core inflation and examining the role of consumption baskets and expenditure weights, this paper offers an interpretive analysis relevant to both policymakers and business decision-makers. The findings highlight the limitations of relying solely on headline inflation for assessing consumer welfare and emphasize the importance of nuanced inflation interpretation for pricing, wage planning, and strategic decision-making.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了印度官方通胀指标与家庭实际通胀体验之间的差异，指出仅依赖总体通胀指标评估消费者福利的局限性，强调需要更细致地解读通胀数据以支持政策制定和商业决策。
AI.research_question: 为什么印度官方通胀指标与家庭实际通胀体验存在显著差异？如何解释这种差异对政策制定和商业决策的影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然官方CPI通胀数据经常显示温和水平，但印度家庭持续感受到基本商品和服务成本的显著上涨，这种感知差异需要解释，因为它对消费者福利评估和政策有效性有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于通胀测量理论，特别是总体通胀与核心通胀的概念区分，以及消费篮子和支出权重在通胀计算中的作用。
AI.method: 概念性比较分析，通过对比总体通胀与核心通胀，并考察消费篮子和支出权重的作用，进行解释性分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现官方通胀指标未能充分反映家庭实际体验的通胀压力，特别是基本商品和服务的成本上涨，这揭示了仅依赖总体通胀指标评估消费者福利的局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于深化了对通胀测量与实际体验差异的理解，强调了通胀指标解释的复杂性，为通胀测量理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括为政策制定者提供更准确评估消费者福利的工具，为商业决策者（定价、工资规划、战略决策）提供更细致通胀解读的指导，提高通胀相关决策的有效性。

title: Technological Change in the Mexican Manufacturing Sector and Its Contribution to Economic Growth

detail.title: Technological Change in the Mexican Manufacturing Sector and Its Contribution to Economic Growth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The manufacturing sector is crucial for the Mexican economy, significantly contributing to GDP and generating millions of jobs. However, it faces substantial challenges in innovation and the adoption of new technologies. This study examines technological change in the Mexican manufacturing sector from 1990 to 2019, assessing whether there has been significant progress and identifying the main drivers of its economic growth. Although advanced technologies have been adopted, their integration has not been sufficient to drive significant change. Dependence on imported inputs and limited government policies also hinder innovation. Using a longitudinal panel data model based on Solow's theory, the study concludes that technological change has been minimal, and economic growth has been primarily driven by labor expansion. The research reveals that Mexico has faced technological difficulties compared to other countries due to structural challenges, low investment in R&D, and outdated infrastructure. A comprehensive policy is recommended to enhance the sector's competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1990-2019年墨西哥制造业的技术变革，发现尽管采用了先进技术，但技术变革有限，经济增长主要依赖劳动力扩张而非技术创新。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥制造业在1990-2019年间是否实现了显著的技术变革？其经济增长的主要驱动力是什么？
AI.motivation: 制造业对墨西哥经济至关重要，但面临创新和技术采用方面的重大挑战，需要评估其技术变革进展和经济增长驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于索洛增长理论，分析技术变革对经济增长的贡献。
AI.method: 使用纵向面板数据模型，分析1990-2019年墨西哥制造业的数据。
AI.findings: 技术变革有限，先进技术整合不足；经济增长主要依赖劳动力扩张；依赖进口投入和政府政策不足阻碍创新；面临结构性挑战、研发投资低和基础设施陈旧等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了索洛理论在发展中国家制造业技术变革分析中的应用，揭示了技术变革与经济增长关系的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议制定综合性政策提升制造业竞争力，包括减少进口依赖、增加研发投资、改善基础设施和优化政府政策。

title: The Marginal Impact of Emission Reductions: Estimates, Beliefs and Behavior

detail.title: The Marginal Impact of Emission Reductions: Estimates, Beliefs and Behavior

publicationDetails.detailsText: SIEPR Working Paper 25‑33

detail.abstract: An important driver of climate change inaction is the belief that individuals cannot have any tangible impact on climate change through their own actions. Currently available statistics are not suited to systematically assess or challenge this belief. In this paper, I derive the marginal impact of emission reductions – the effect of reducing emissions by 1 tonne of CO₂ (tCO₂) – on physical climate change outcomes, document important misperceptions, show how they affect behavior, and derive policy implications. Using climate models, I find that the impact of reducing emissions by 1 tCO₂ is thousands of liters less glacier ice melting, several additional hours of aggregate life expectancy, and multiple m² less vegetation undergoing ecosystem change. Subjects underestimate these figures by orders of magnitude. Moreover, their mental model is inconsistent with climate models. First, they misperceive climate change as a threshold public goods game. Second, they incorrectly assume that the marginal impact increases when others also reduce their emissions (strategic complementarity). Providing subjects with the climate scientific findings causally increases perceived self-efficacy, intentions to reduce own emissions, and real donations to reduce global emissions. The misperceptions and treatment effect are consistent with a mental model of threshold thinking, which predicts positive overall emission reductions of information provision in equilibrium. Providing information about the marginal impact is a cost-effective demand-side mitigation strategy. The information can also serve as a catalyst for other climate policies by reframing their benefits and challenging arguments against unilateral action that are based on threshold thinking.

AI.tldr: 本文通过气候模型量化了减少1吨CO₂排放的实际边际影响（减少数千升冰川融化、增加数小时总寿命等），发现人们严重低估这些影响且存在阈值思维误区。提供这些科学信息能提高自我效能感、促进减排行为，是一种成本有效的需求侧减排策略。
AI.research_question: 减少1吨CO₂排放对气候变化结果的实际边际影响是什么？人们对此的认知误区如何影响减排行为？提供科学信息能否有效促进减排？
AI.motivation: 气候变化不作为的重要驱动因素是认为个人行动无法产生实质性影响。现有统计数据无法系统评估或挑战这一信念，需要量化个人减排的实际边际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值公共物品博弈理论、战略互补性、边际影响分析、自我效能理论、行为经济学中的认知偏差
AI.method: 使用气候模型计算减少1吨CO₂排放的边际物理影响；通过实验调查受试者的认知偏差；进行干预实验测试信息提供对行为的影响
AI.findings: 减少1吨CO₂可减少数千升冰川融化、增加数小时总寿命、减少多平方米植被生态系统变化；受试者严重低估这些影响（数量级差异）；存在阈值思维误区（将气候变化视为阈值公共物品博弈）和战略互补性误解；提供科学信息能提高自我效能感、增强减排意愿、增加实际捐款
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化个人减排的边际物理影响；识别气候变化认知中的阈值思维误区；建立信息干预促进减排的理论机制；挑战"个人行动无效"的普遍信念
AI.practical_contributions: 提供成本有效的需求侧减排策略；为气候政策提供催化剂，重新框架政策收益；挑战基于阈值思维的单边行动反对论点；提供可操作的气候沟通工具

title: Class Position and Gender Regimes: Equality as a High-Surplus Equilibrium
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Class Position and Gender Regimes: Equality as a High-Surplus Equilibrium

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a theoretical/conceptual paper and does not involve human participants, animals, or proprietary data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial or not-for-profit.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a structural equilibrium model linking class position to gender regimes. It argues that gender equality is not a free-floating moral ideal but a highsurplus equilibrium produced by stable resources, female portable capital, and thick institutions. Let surplus stability be S, female portable capital be P_f, and institutional thickness be I. Patriarchy intensity G is hypothesized to rise as these variables decline, because male control becomes a low-cost coordination substitute under survival volatility. Formally, G = α/S + β/P_f + γ/I + ε, an inverse-linear first-order approximation capturing diminishing marginal effects of surplus, portable capital, and institutions on patriarchal stability. The model yields testable predictions: surplus shocks increase patriarchy within cultures; institutional strengthening reduces patriarchy ahead of value change; rising P_f lowers patriarchy through improved female exit options; and blocked male status routes amplify patriarchal signaling. Boundary conditions are specified for lineage-control aristocracies and ideology-driven regimes. By reframing gender relations as class-conditioned equilibria, the paper offers an empirical agenda for explaining cross-societal variation in patriarchy and equality.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个结构均衡模型，将阶级地位与性别制度联系起来，认为性别平等不是自由漂浮的道德理想，而是在稳定资源、女性可携带资本和厚实制度下产生的高盈余均衡。
AI.research_question: 性别不平等（父权制强度）如何受到阶级结构条件（盈余稳定性、女性可携带资本、制度厚度）的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统性别研究往往将性别平等视为道德理想或文化价值观问题，忽视了其结构性基础。本文旨在揭示性别关系实际上是阶级条件化的均衡结果，而非纯粹的文化现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构均衡理论、阶级分析、制度经济学、博弈论（协调替代机制）
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建形式化结构均衡模型：G = α/S + β/P_f + γ/I + ε，其中G为父权制强度，S为盈余稳定性，P_f为女性可携带资本，I为制度厚度
AI.findings: 模型预测：1) 盈余冲击会增加文化内部的父权制；2) 制度强化会在价值观变化之前减少父权制；3) 女性可携带资本增加通过改善女性退出选择降低父权制；4) 男性地位上升路径受阻会放大父权信号传递
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将性别关系重构为阶级条件化的均衡；2) 提出父权制作为低成本的协调替代机制；3) 为解释跨社会父权制和性别平等差异提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供解释性别不平等跨社会差异的实证研究议程；2) 识别影响性别制度的关键结构变量；3) 为政策干预（如增强女性资本、稳定盈余、强化制度）提供理论基础

title: Labor Market Power, Firm Productivity, and the Immigrant-Native Pay Gap
affiliations: Toronto Metropolitan University

detail.title: Labor Market Power, Firm Productivity, and the Immigrant-Native Pay Gap
detail.abstract: This paper examines the importance of labor market power and firm productivity for understanding the immigrant-native pay gap. Using matched employer-employee data covering the universe of Canadian tax filers, I estimate an oligopsony model of the labor market with heterogeneous workers and firms. The results reveal two opposing forces: firms have more labor market power over immigrants—marking down wages by 23% for immigrants compared to 16% for natives—yet immigrants sort into more productive firms. To decompose the immigrant-native pay gap, I use the model to conduct counterfactual experiments in a general equilibrium framework.

AI.tldr: 本文使用加拿大雇主-雇员匹配数据，通过寡头垄断劳动力市场模型分析移民与本地人工资差距。研究发现两个相反力量：企业对移民有更强的劳动力市场势力（移民工资被压低23%，本地人16%），但移民会进入生产率更高的企业。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场势力和企业生产率如何影响移民与本地人的工资差距？
AI.motivation: 理解移民与本地人工资差距的驱动因素，特别是劳动力市场势力（企业定价权）和企业生产率异质性在其中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头垄断（oligopsony）劳动力市场模型，包含异质性工人和异质性企业。
AI.method: 使用加拿大全体纳税人雇主-雇员匹配数据，估计寡头垄断劳动力市场模型，并进行一般均衡框架下的反事实实验分解工资差距。
AI.findings: 1. 企业对移民有更强的劳动力市场势力（移民工资被压低23%，本地人16%）；2. 移民会进入生产率更高的企业；3. 这两个力量对工资差距产生相反影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动力市场势力（寡头垄断）和企业生产率异质性纳入移民工资差距分析框架，提供了更全面的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解移民工资差距的根源提供实证依据，有助于设计更有效的劳动力市场政策来减少移民工资歧视。

title: UniROIS -Universal ROI System: A Hybrid Monte-Carlo and Agent-based Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: UniROIS -Universal ROI System: A Hybrid Monte-Carlo and Agent-based Framework
detail.abstract: UniROIS is a practical, scalable framework for evaluating Return on Investment (ROI) across individual projects, functional departments, and the entire enterprise. Traditional point-estimate ROI models understate risk and miss emergent phenomena such as virality or cross-departmental synergy. UniROIS combines large-scale Monte-Carlo simulation to capture parameter uncertainty with an Agent-Based Model (ABM) layer to capture interactions, network effects, and temporal dynamics. The system supports both bottom-up and top-down workflows and integrates probabilistic attribution (P(apply) × P(persist) × P(isolate)) to deliver decision-ready metrics: median ROI, P10-P90 intervals, probability of positive return (P(ROI>0)), and sensitivity drivers.

AI.tldr: UniROIS是一个实用的、可扩展的框架，用于评估从单个项目到整个企业的投资回报率。它通过结合大规模蒙特卡洛模拟和基于代理的模型来克服传统点估计模型的局限性，提供更全面的风险分析和决策指标。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够准确评估跨层级（项目、部门、企业）投资回报率，同时考虑不确定性、网络效应和动态交互的综合性框架？
AI.motivation: 传统的点估计ROI模型低估风险，无法捕捉病毒效应、跨部门协同等新兴现象，需要更全面的评估方法来支持企业决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合蒙特卡洛模拟（处理参数不确定性）和基于代理的模型（捕捉交互、网络效应和时间动态）的混合建模框架，以及概率归因理论（P(apply) × P(persist) × P(isolate)）。
AI.method: 开发UniROIS框架，集成大规模蒙特卡洛模拟和基于代理的模型层，支持自下而上和自上而下的工作流程，提供概率归因和决策就绪指标。
AI.findings: UniROIS能够提供更全面的ROI评估，包括中位数ROI、P10-P90区间、正回报概率（P(ROI>0)）和敏感性驱动因素，克服了传统模型的局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合蒙特卡洛模拟和基于代理模型的混合ROI评估框架，引入了概率归因方法，为复杂系统下的投资决策提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了实用的、可扩展的ROI评估工具，支持跨层级决策，能够识别风险、捕捉协同效应，并提供决策就绪的量化指标。

title:
Why General Embodied Intelligence Is Structurally Impossible:
A One-World Ontological Critique of the Humanoid Robot Paradigm
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
Why General Embodied Intelligence Is Structurally Impossible:
A One-World Ontological Critique of the Humanoid Robot Paradigm
detail.abstract:
Humanoid robots are widely framed as the inevitable culmination of artificial intelligence.
From large language models to multimodal perception and embodied agents, a dominant narrative claims that “general embodied intelligence” is merely an engineering milestone away.

This paper argues that this narrative is fundamentally mistaken.

We show that the failure of general humanoid intelligence is not an engineering bottleneck, a data shortage, or a temporary lack of compute, but a structural impossibility rooted in a misunderstanding of how the world, intelligence, and causality actually operate.

Using a One-World ontological framework, we demonstrate that symbolic and perceptual data are not the world itself but manifestations of a deeper thought structure.
Attempting to reconstruct causal agency from manifestations alone is logically incoherent and leads to an unsolvable convergence problem in open physical environments.

We prove that general embodied intelligence is not a compressible problem: the physical world is continuous, open-ended, high-dimensional, and governed by existential thought loops rather than computable state transitions.
As a result, scaling laws that succeed in symbolic domains necessarily collapse when transferred into embodied reality.

Finally, we propose a positive alternative: soft intelligence embedded within closed institutional worlds.
Rather than building “general humanoid minds,” the real civilizational transformation will arise from soft intelligence systems operating inside tightly constrained, closed-loop environments—factories, hospitals, logistics systems, and governance institutions—where causality becomes learnable, verification becomes possible, and intelligence becomes deliverable.

This reframes artificial intelligence not as a path toward artificial life, but as a new institutional layer of civilization.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了"通用人形机器人智能是AI必然终点"的主流叙事，认为这是结构性不可能，并提出"软智能"作为替代方案。
AI.research_question: 通用人形机器人智能是否可能实现？为什么当前主流叙事是错误的？
AI.motivation: 当前AI领域存在一种主流叙事，认为从大语言模型到多模态感知和具身智能体，"通用具身智能"只是一个工程里程碑问题。本文旨在挑战这一错误叙事。
AI.theoretical_framework: One-World本体论框架，认为符号和感知数据不是世界本身，而是更深层思维结构的体现。物理世界是连续、开放、高维的，由存在性思维循环而非可计算状态转换支配。
AI.method: 理论论证和逻辑分析，证明从表现重建因果代理在逻辑上是不连贯的，在开放物理环境中存在不可解的收敛问题。
AI.findings: 通用具身智能不是可压缩问题；符号领域成功的缩放定律在转移到具身现实时会崩溃；通用人形智能是结构性不可能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战了通用人形智能的主流叙事；2) 提出了One-World本体论框架；3) 证明了通用具身智能的结构性不可能；4) 提出了软智能作为替代理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"软智能"的实践方向：在工厂、医院、物流系统和治理机构等封闭制度世界中嵌入智能系统，使因果关系可学习、验证可行、智能可交付。

title: When Wildfires Suppress Crime: A Spatial Analysis of Post-Wildfire Trends in Los Angeles
affiliations: Georgia Southern University, CUNY, John Jay College of Criminal Justice and The University of Tampa

detail.title: When Wildfires Suppress Crime: A Spatial Analysis of Post-Wildfire Trends in Los Angeles
detail.abstract: Natural disasters can fundamentally disrupt the social and physical environments of urban areas, reshaping the conditions under which crime occurs. This study examines how major wildfires have influenced crime patterns across Los Angeles County, CA, from 2015 to 2025. Drawing on opportunity-based frameworks from environmental criminology, we assess how displacement, guardianship disruptions, and land-use change after wildfires can alter spatial and temporal crime dynamics. A dataset of 27,612 geocoded crime incidents was aggregated to 1-km² grid cells for analysis. Mann-Kendall tests within a space-time cube identified significant temporal trends, geographically weighted regression (GWR) measured spatial heterogeneity in wildfire-crime relationships, and a distance-of-distances analysis evaluated post-wildfire shifts in the dispersion of crime events. Results show that wildfire-exposed areas were significantly more likely to experience long-term decreases in crime than unexposed areas, with suppression effects clustering around burn perimeters. GWR results revealed strong local variation, indicating geographically uneven wildfire impacts. Together, these findings suggest that wildfires reshape both the magnitude and geography of urban crime. The study advances the geography of crime by integrating spatial data science, environmental risk, and criminological theory, demonstrating that disasters may sometimes suppress rather than amplify criminal opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析洛杉矶县2015-2025年野火对犯罪模式的影响，发现野火暴露区域犯罪率长期下降，且抑制效应集中在燃烧边界周围，表明自然灾害可能抑制而非放大犯罪机会。
AI.research_question: 重大野火如何影响洛杉矶县犯罪模式的空间和时间动态？
AI.motivation: 自然灾害能从根本上破坏城市的社会和物理环境，重塑犯罪发生的条件，但野火对犯罪模式的具体影响机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境犯罪学的机会理论框架，包括位移、监护中断和土地利用变化等概念。
AI.method: 使用27,612个地理编码犯罪事件数据集，聚合到1平方公里网格单元；采用空间-时间立方体中的Mann-Kendall检验识别时间趋势，地理加权回归(GWR)测量空间异质性，距离分析评估野火后犯罪事件的分散变化。
AI.findings: 野火暴露区域比未暴露区域更可能经历犯罪的长期下降，抑制效应集中在燃烧边界周围；GWR显示强烈的局部变异，表明野火影响在地理上不均匀。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过整合空间数据科学、环境风险和犯罪学理论，推进了犯罪地理学；证明灾害有时可能抑制而非放大犯罪机会。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾害管理和城市规划提供实证依据，帮助理解自然灾害后犯罪模式的变化规律，指导资源分配和风险缓解策略。

title: "Understanding Computer Networks: A Comprehensive Overview of Types, Configurations, and the OSI Model"
affiliations: Bulacan State University

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by University Research Grant, ABC Technology Foundation under Grant Number

detail.abstract:
In the modern era, computer networks form the invisible backbone of global communication, commerce, education, and social interaction. From small office setups connecting a handful of devices to vast infrastructures spanning continents, networks enable the seamless exchange of data that underpins nearly every aspect of contemporary life. As technology continues to evolve at an unprecedented pace with advancements like 5G and 6G wireless systems, software-defined networking (SDN), edge computing, and the Internet of Things (IoT) transforming how we design, deploy, and use networks the need for clear, accurate, and up-to-date educational resources has never been more critical. Introductory materials play a vital role in equipping learners, professionals, and decision-makers with the foundational knowledge required to navigate this complex field, making it essential that such resources are both comprehensive in scope and aligned with current industry and academic standards.
Against this backdrop, the article Understanding Computer Networks: A Comprehensive Overview of Types, Configurations, and the OSI Model by Priyanshu Tyagi, Rahul Nishant, and Priyadarshi purports to deliver a thorough exploration of core networking concepts. Originally published in the International Journal of Trend in Research and Development in 2015, the work was re-submitted to the arXiv preprint server in March 2024 without any apparent updates to its content. The paper’s title promises coverage of network configurations, types, communication links, and the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model key areas that form the bedrock of networking literacy. Additionally, its abstract emphasizes the transformative impact of intranets and internets, framing these technologies as central to modern computing and business competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提供了计算机网络的全面概述，涵盖网络类型、配置和OSI模型等核心概念，旨在为学习者提供基础网络知识的教育资源。
AI.research_question: 如何全面介绍计算机网络的核心概念，包括网络类型、配置、通信链路和OSI模型，以提供基础网络教育？
AI.motivation: 随着5G/6G、SDN、边缘计算和物联网等技术的快速发展，对清晰、准确、最新的教育资源需求日益迫切，需要为学习者、专业人士和决策者提供全面的基础网络知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算机网络基础理论，特别是OSI（开放系统互连）模型，以及网络类型学、配置理论和通信链路原理。
AI.method: 采用概念性综述方法，系统性地梳理和解释计算机网络的核心概念、分类和架构。
AI.findings: 论文提供了计算机网络的全面概述，详细解释了不同类型的网络、配置方式、通信链路以及OSI模型的各层功能，强调了内联网和互联网在现代计算和商业竞争中的核心作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整理了计算机网络的基础理论框架，特别是对OSI模型的详细解释，为网络教育提供了结构化的知识体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学习者、专业人士和决策者提供了实用的网络基础知识，有助于他们理解和应用现代网络技术，特别是在快速发展的技术环境中做出明智决策。

title: Volatility Transmission to Bitcoin: The Role of VIX Term Structure and Crypto Options Markets
affiliations: National Sun Yat-sen University, Oregon State University and Soochow University, Taiwan

detail.title: Volatility Transmission to Bitcoin: The Role of VIX Term Structure and Crypto Options Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: INTFIN-D-26-00130

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of cryptocurrency implied volatility and the CBOE VIX term structure on Bitcoin returns from March 2021 to May 2025. Using PCA and an orthogonalization framework, we identify the VIX term structure’s slope factor as a primary determinant of contemporaneous Bitcoin returns. While Bitcoin shows strong negative responses to VIX and crypto-implied volatility across all maturities, the VIX slope factor exhibits superior explanatory power. Notably, following the January 2024 U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF approval, Bitcoin's sensitivity to its own implied volatility significantly attenuated, while its responsiveness to the VIX remained unchanged. A placebo test confirms this structural shift, suggesting that ETF institutionalization has altered Bitcoin’s internal risk dynamics without decoupling it from broader equity market volatility.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了加密货币隐含波动率和CBOE VIX期限结构对比特币收益率的影响。研究发现VIX期限结构的斜率因子是比特币同期收益率的主要决定因素。比特币对所有期限的VIX和加密货币隐含波动率都呈现强烈负向反应，但VIX斜率因子的解释力最强。值得注意的是，2024年1月美国现货比特币ETF获批后，比特币对自身隐含波动率的敏感性显著减弱，但对VIX的响应保持不变。
AI.research_question: 加密货币隐含波动率和CBOE VIX期限结构如何影响比特币收益率？这些关系在2024年1月美国现货比特币ETF获批后是否发生变化？
AI.motivation: 随着加密货币市场的发展，理解比特币与传统金融市场（特别是波动率指标）的关系变得越来越重要。美国现货比特币ETF的批准可能改变了比特币的风险动态，需要实证检验这种结构性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于波动率期限结构理论、风险溢价理论和资产定价理论。使用VIX期限结构（斜率因子）作为市场风险预期的代理变量，加密货币隐含波动率作为特定资产风险指标。
AI.method: 使用主成分分析（PCA）提取VIX期限结构的关键因子，采用正交化框架分离不同波动率因子的影响。分析时间范围为2021年3月至2025年5月，以2024年1月ETF批准为分界点进行结构变化检验，并使用安慰剂测试验证结果稳健性。
AI.findings: 1. VIX期限结构的斜率因子是比特币同期收益率的主要决定因素；2. 比特币对所有期限的VIX和加密货币隐含波动率都呈现强烈负向反应；3. ETF批准后，比特币对自身隐含波动率的敏感性显著减弱，但对VIX的响应保持不变；4. 安慰剂测试确认了这种结构性变化，表明ETF机构化改变了比特币的内部风险动态，但未使其与更广泛的股票市场波动脱钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地将VIX期限结构因子纳入比特币定价模型；2. 揭示了比特币风险动态的结构性变化机制；3. 为理解机构化对加密货币市场的影响提供了理论框架；4. 扩展了波动率期限结构理论在数字资产领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了基于VIX期限结构的比特币交易策略；2. 帮助风险管理从业者更好地评估比特币的风险暴露；3. 为监管机构理解ETF批准对市场结构的影响提供实证依据；4. 为资产配置决策提供关于比特币与传统市场关联性的最新证据。

title: Workers who are (not) employees: Towards decent work, access to labor standards and social protection
affiliations: University of the Western Cape, University of the Western Cape, University of the Western Cape and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Workers who are (not) employees: Towards decent work, access to labor standards and social protection

contentType.other: A think piece prepared for NEDLAC for consideration in terms of labour law and policy development

contentFormat.other: Policy paper supporting government and social partners in national social dialogue institute

detail.abstract:
Globally, the COVID-19 pandemic intensified focus on remote work and raised the need to evaluate the adequacy of labour legislation and workplace policies in the context of hybrid and remote-work arrangements. Remote work is characterised by the use of digital technology to perform tasks outside of the employer’s premises, often at the employee’s home. While it offers flexibility, inclusivity, and environmental benefits, it presents challenges too, for example in regard to enforcing employment standards, maintaining work-life balance, privacy, health and safety, and avoiding the risk of worker invisibility. Similarly, remote work poses difficulties for performance management and access to the workplace for inspection purposes.

Key issues explored in this report include the regulation of working hours, occupational health and safety concerns, and compensation for occupational injuries. The report proposes the development of regulatory mechanisms — regulations and a Code of Good Practice — for remote work to provide certainty to remote workers and safeguard their well-being while balancing this with the interests of employers. The report thus provides guidance on remote-work policies in the workplace. Additionally, it considers legislative developments on flexible working arrangements that respond to the evolving nature of work in the digital era, promote work-life balance, and support gender equality.

AI.tldr: 该报告探讨COVID-19疫情下远程工作的监管挑战，提出通过法规和行为准则来平衡远程工作者权益与雇主利益，为职场远程工作政策提供指导。
AI.research_question: 在混合和远程工作安排背景下，如何评估劳动法规和工作场所政策的充分性，并制定有效的监管机制来保障远程工作者权益？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情加剧了对远程工作的关注，凸显了现有劳动法规在远程工作环境中的不足，需要解决就业标准执行、工作生活平衡、隐私保护、健康安全等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动法规理论、数字时代工作性质演变理论、工作生活平衡理论、性别平等理论，以及职业健康安全框架。
AI.method: 政策分析报告方法，通过文献综述和问题识别，提出监管机制建议（法规和行为准则）。
AI.findings: 远程工作面临工作时间监管、职业健康安全、工伤赔偿等关键问题；需要专门的监管机制来保障远程工作者权益，同时平衡雇主利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字时代劳动法规理论，提出了适应远程工作环境的监管框架，丰富了工作生活平衡和性别平等在远程工作背景下的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供远程工作政策指导；提出具体的监管机制（法规和行为准则）建议；促进灵活工作安排立法发展，支持工作生活平衡和性别平等。

title: ESG Risk Monitoring of European Companies: Sentometrics Data Protocols
affiliations: Ghent University and Sentometrics

detail.title: ESG Risk Monitoring of European Companies: Sentometrics Data Protocols
detail.abstract: This document outlines the data protocols that underpin the Sentometrics ESG Risk Monitoring product. It explains how ESG Risk Cases involving European companies are systematically identified, validated, classified, and maintained using a robust, norm-based methodology. The protocols combine internationally recognised frameworks-primarily the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Global Compact Principles-with alignment to key EU sustainability regulations such as CSRD, CSDDD, SFDR, and the EU Taxonomy. The document details the universe definition, thresholds for case inclusion, source selection, severity assessment, status categorisation, and update procedures. It also describes the workflow integrating AI-driven signal detection with expert human validation, as well as the process for integrating direct company feedback. Together, these protocols ensure consistency, transparency, and regulatory relevance in the Sentometrics ESG Risk Monitoring product.

AI.tldr: 本文档描述了Sentometrics ESG风险监测产品的数据协议，详细说明了如何通过基于规范的方法系统识别、验证、分类和维护涉及欧洲公司的ESG风险案例，结合国际框架与欧盟法规，确保产品的一致性、透明度和监管相关性。
AI.research_question: 如何建立系统化、透明且符合监管要求的ESG风险监测数据协议？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG投资和监管要求的增加，需要建立标准化的风险监测方法，确保ESG风险评估的一致性和可靠性，满足投资者和监管机构的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际公认框架（OECD跨国企业指南、联合国全球契约原则）与欧盟可持续发展法规（CSRD、CSDDD、SFDR、欧盟分类法）的规范基础方法。
AI.method: 结合AI驱动的信号检测与专家人工验证的工作流程，包括案例识别、验证、分类、维护的全过程，以及公司直接反馈的整合机制。
AI.findings: 建立了一套完整的ESG风险监测数据协议，涵盖案例定义、纳入阈值、来源选择、严重性评估、状态分类和更新程序，确保产品的一致性和透明度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将国际框架与区域监管要求相结合的系统化ESG风险监测方法论，为ESG风险评估提供了规范化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了可靠的ESG风险监测工具，帮助识别和管理欧洲公司的ESG风险，支持合规决策和风险管理。

title: Learning to Discern Misinformation: Evidence from a Field Experiment in India
affiliations: and

detail.title: Learning to Discern Misinformation: Evidence from a Field Experiment in India
detail.abstract: We conduct a large field experiment in India testing an intervention aimed at improving people's ability to discern misinformation and reducing misperceptions about minority groups. Participants received weekly digests featuring fact-checks of viral misinformation. The intervention increased participants' ability to correctly identify misinformation by 11 percentage points, although it also led to a 4 percentage point reduction in belief in true news. We estimate a structural model to disentangle the underlying impact mechanisms and find that the intervention increases both truth discernment ability and skepticism. The intervention also corrected people's misperceptions about minorities and changed policy opinions.

AI.tldr: 在印度进行的大规模实地实验显示，每周推送事实核查摘要能提高11%的虚假信息识别能力，但也会降低4%的真实新闻信任度。干预措施通过提高真相辨别能力和怀疑态度来发挥作用，同时纠正对少数群体的误解并改变政策观点。
AI.research_question: 旨在改善人们辨别虚假信息能力的干预措施是否能有效提高对虚假信息的识别能力，同时减少对少数群体的误解？
AI.motivation: 虚假信息传播对民主和社会凝聚力构成威胁，特别是在多元社会中，虚假信息可能加剧对少数群体的误解和偏见。需要实证研究来评估干预措施在改善信息辨别能力和减少社会偏见方面的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息处理理论、认知心理学中的真相辨别能力概念，以及怀疑态度在信息评估中的作用。同时涉及偏见减少和社会认知理论。
AI.method: 在印度进行的大规模实地实验，参与者每周接收包含病毒式虚假信息事实核查的摘要。使用结构模型来分离潜在的影响机制。
AI.findings: 干预措施将参与者正确识别虚假信息的能力提高了11个百分点，但同时也导致对真实新闻的信任度降低了4个百分点。结构模型分析显示，干预措施既提高了真相辨别能力，也增强了怀疑态度。此外，干预还纠正了人们对少数群体的误解并改变了政策观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了关于事实核查干预对信息辨别能力影响机制的实证证据；2) 揭示了干预措施在提高真相辨别能力的同时可能产生的副作用（降低真实新闻信任度）；3) 展示了信息干预如何通过改变认知机制来影响社会态度和政策观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者和媒体组织提供了有效的虚假信息干预方案；2) 指出了在设计和实施事实核查项目时需要平衡提高虚假信息识别能力和保持对真实新闻信任的重要性；3) 展示了信息干预在减少社会偏见和促进社会凝聚力方面的潜力。

title: Incomplete Markets and Exchange Rates
affiliations: University of California, Davis and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

detail.title: Incomplete Markets and Exchange Rates
detail.abstract: We show that imperfect risk-sharing within countries can reconcile the aggregate cyclicality of exchange rates in a two-country setting, i.e. the Backus-Smith puzzle, as long as exchange rates are sufficiently risky with respect to idiosyncratic states. Leveraging theory mapping household heterogeneity into measurable discount-factor wedges, we use household-level data to provide direct empirical support for our mechanism. We then embed this insight in an equilibrium asset-pricing model and show that the observed exchange rate dynamics require that, even when a country experiences higher consumption growth, idiosyncratic risk remains relatively elevated. In a quantitative exercise, we disentangle distinct roles for market incompleteness both within and across countries and match key moments of asset prices and exchange rates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入国家内部不完全风险分担机制，解决了Backus-Smith谜题（汇率与消费增长相关性异常），证明只要汇率对异质性状态足够风险，就能解释汇率的总体周期性特征。
AI.research_question: 国家内部的不完全风险分担如何解释汇率的总体周期性特征（Backus-Smith谜题）？
AI.motivation: 传统国际宏观模型无法解释Backus-Smith谜题，即汇率与相对消费增长之间的相关性异常。本文认为国家内部的风险分担不完全性可能是关键机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不完全风险分担理论，将家庭异质性映射到可测量的贴现因子楔子，建立均衡资产定价模型。
AI.method: 1. 理论推导：将家庭异质性映射到贴现因子楔子；2. 实证分析：使用家庭层面数据验证机制；3. 定量模拟：嵌入均衡资产定价模型，匹配资产价格和汇率的关键矩。
AI.findings: 1. 国家内部不完全风险分担可以解释Backus-Smith谜题；2. 汇率对异质性状态足够风险时机制成立；3. 即使国家经历更高消费增长，异质性风险仍然相对较高；4. 能够匹配资产价格和汇率的关键矩。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为Backus-Smith谜题提供新的理论解释；2. 建立家庭异质性到贴现因子楔子的映射理论；3. 阐明国家内部和跨国市场不完全性的不同作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为汇率预测和政策分析提供新视角；2. 帮助理解风险分担不完全性的宏观经济影响；3. 为资产定价和风险管理提供实证依据。

title: Structural Transformation in Russia-Indonesia Trade: From Commodity Consolidation to Technological Partnership
affiliations: MGIMO University

detail.title: Structural Transformation in Russia-Indonesia Trade: From Commodity Consolidation to Technological Partnership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available statistical and corporate data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the evolution of trade cooperation between Russia and Indonesia from 2020 to 2024, a period marked by structural shocks in the global economy. Utilizing a two-tiered analytical framework, the study combines macro-level trade flow analysis from UN Comtrade data with a micro-level examination of Indonesia's corporate sector through listed companies on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX). The findings reveal a post-2022 "shock consolidation" trend, where bilateral trade has narrowed to a stable but primitive exchange of critical commodities: Russian energy, grain, and fertilizers for Indonesian vegetable oils. This has come at the cost of a "complexity regression," with high-value-added goods disappearing from trade flows. However, analysis of the Indonesian corporate landscape identifies underlying drivers for diversification. Sectors like Materials, Industrials, and Consumer Staples are engaged in significant capital expenditure, creating latent demand for technological and infrastructural solutions. The paper concludes that the established commodity trade platform should be leveraged to facilitate a transition towards B2B technological partnerships. The impending Free Trade Agreement between the EAEU and Indonesia presents a critical window of opportunity to shift from a model of "commodity stagnation" to one of "technological reassembly.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2020-2024年俄印贸易合作演变，发现后2022年呈现"冲击巩固"趋势：双边贸易缩减为关键商品交换（俄罗斯能源、粮食、化肥换印尼植物油），导致"复杂性回归"（高附加值商品消失）。但印尼企业资本支出显示多样化潜力，建议利用现有商品贸易平台转向B2B技术合作，借助即将达成的EAEU-印尼自贸协定实现从"商品停滞"到"技术重组"的转型。
AI.research_question: 2020-2024年期间，俄罗斯与印尼的贸易合作如何演变？特别是在全球结构性冲击背景下，双边贸易模式发生了哪些变化？是否存在从初级商品贸易向更复杂技术合作转型的潜力？
AI.motivation: 全球经济的结构性冲击（特别是2022年后）对新兴经济体间的贸易关系产生了深远影响。俄罗斯与印尼作为重要新兴经济体，其贸易合作模式的变化反映了全球供应链重组和地缘经济调整的现实。理解这种演变对于预测未来南南合作趋势和制定有效贸易政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用双层分析框架：宏观层面的贸易流量分析（基于UN Comtrade数据）和微观层面的企业行为分析（基于印尼上市公司数据）。结合国际贸易理论、供应链重组理论和企业战略理论，分析从初级商品贸易向技术合作转型的路径。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1）宏观层面：使用UN Comtrade数据分析2020-2024年俄印双边贸易流量和结构变化；2）微观层面：分析印尼证券交易所（IDX）上市公司数据，特别是材料、工业和消费品行业的资本支出模式，识别技术需求潜力。
AI.findings: 1）后2022年出现"冲击巩固"趋势：贸易缩减为关键商品交换（俄罗斯能源、粮食、化肥换印尼植物油）；2）"复杂性回归"：高附加值商品从贸易流中消失；3）印尼企业部门显示多样化潜力：材料、工业和消费品行业有显著资本支出，创造对技术和基础设施解决方案的潜在需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"冲击巩固"和"复杂性回归"概念，描述危机时期贸易关系的简化趋势；2）发展双层分析框架，将宏观贸易模式与微观企业行为联系起来；3）为新兴经济体间贸易合作从商品基础向技术合作转型提供理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供具体建议：利用现有商品贸易平台促进B2B技术合作；2）识别即将达成的EAEU-印尼自贸协定为关键机会窗口；3）为印尼企业提供战略指导：如何从"商品停滞"转向"技术重组"模式，实现贸易升级。

title: Building A Credit-Driven Society as Nigeria’s Next Economic Frontier
affiliations: Independent and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Building A Credit-Driven Society as Nigeria’s Next Economic Frontier
detail.abstract:
Nigeria’s economic structure is still largely cash-based. This has meant that a large portion of the people still cannot access essential goods, asset ownership, and productive capital. On the other hand, advanced economies are able to use consumer credit as one of the main engines of their growth. This gives individuals and businesses the ability to spread costs over time, build wealth and plan for the future. According to this article, a strong, inclusive, and well, regulated consumer credit system could be the next major economic frontier for Nigeria.

The paper, which is based on comparative insights from developed economies, Nigeria’s current legal and regulatory framework, and informal credit practices such as esusu, and trade credit, shows that Nigerians are culturally credit-oriented but are not provided with scalable and protective formal mechanisms. It also looks at digital financial infrastructure, inclusive credit scoring models, regulatory reforms, financial literacy, and efficient enforcement systems as key components of a credit economy functioning well.

Furthermore, the paper explores the issues of inflation, data fragmentation, and predatory lending, and suggests targeted solutions that include the use of alternative data, digital identity integration, and coordinated regulatory oversight. In the end, the article argues that formalizing and scaling consumer credit with the necessary safeguards for borrower rights can greatly increase financial inclusion, boost productivity, and support sustainable economic growth in Nigeria.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为，尼日利亚以现金为主的经济结构限制了民众获取基本商品、资产和生产资本的能力。通过借鉴发达经济体经验，结合尼日利亚现有法律框架和非正式信贷实践，论文提出建立强大、包容且监管良好的消费信贷体系是尼日利亚下一个主要经济前沿。关键要素包括数字金融基础设施、包容性信用评分模型、监管改革、金融素养和高效执行系统。
AI.research_question: 如何为尼日利亚建立一个强大、包容且监管良好的消费信贷体系，以促进金融包容性、提高生产力和支持可持续经济增长？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚经济结构仍以现金为主，导致大量人口无法获得基本商品、资产所有权和生产资本。相比之下，发达经济体利用消费信贷作为经济增长的主要引擎之一，使个人和企业能够分摊成本、积累财富和规划未来。尼日利亚需要建立正式的消费信贷体系来推动经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 比较分析框架：借鉴发达经济体的消费信贷体系经验
2. 制度经济学：分析尼日利亚当前法律和监管框架
3. 非正式信贷实践理论：研究如esusu（轮转储蓄信贷协会）和贸易信贷等本土实践
4. 金融包容性理论：探讨如何通过正式信贷机制扩大金融服务覆盖
AI.method:
1. 比较研究法：分析发达经济体的消费信贷体系
2. 制度分析法：评估尼日利亚现有法律和监管框架
3. 案例研究：考察非正式信贷实践如esusu和贸易信贷
4. 政策分析：研究数字金融基础设施、信用评分模型、监管改革等关键要素
AI.findings:
1. 尼日利亚人具有文化上的信贷倾向，但缺乏可扩展且有保护性的正式机制
2. 当前体系面临通货膨胀、数据碎片化和掠夺性贷款等问题
3. 数字金融基础设施、包容性信用评分、监管改革、金融素养和高效执行系统是信贷经济良好运行的关键

AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了适用于发展中国家的消费信贷体系理论框架
2. 将非正式信贷实践（如esusu）纳入正式金融体系的理论整合
3. 发展了包容性信用评分模型的理论基础
4. 为制度经济学在金融体系转型中的应用提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions:

2. 提出了解决通货膨胀、数据碎片化和掠夺性贷款等实际问题的方案
3. 强调了借款人权利保护的必要性
4. 展示了如何通过正式化消费信贷来促进金融包容性、提高生产力和支持可持续经济增长

title: Digital Economy Provisions in a Canada-Mercosur Trade Agreement

detail.title: Digital Economy Provisions in a Canada-Mercosur Trade Agreement
detail.abstract: This brief considers the goals that Canada should be pursuing as regards digital economy measures to be included in a Canada-Mercosur Trade Agreement. It takes the digital economy provisions of the recently concluded EU-Mercosur Partnership Agreement (EMPA) as a point of departure given that Mercosur has agreed to them. The brief argues that, while the EMPA represents a positive step toward reinforcing rules-based trade cooperation among small and medium-sized open economies against the background of a rupture in multilateral trade governance, its treatment of the digital economy is largely WTO-minus relative to the Joint Statement Initiative on E-Commerce and insufficiently adapted to the realities of the emerging era of machine knowledge capital. The analysis focuses on three core design issues. First, the EMPA’s limited and fragmented e-commerce provisions fall short in articulating legal frameworks for e-commerce in enabling areas such as, inter alia, paperless trade, digital payments, and trusted digital infrastructure that have now been accepted at the multilateral level in the WTO’s Joint Statement Initiative stabilized text on e-commerce. Second, the agreement perpetuates the unresolved WTO practice of treating cross-border digital flows as ambiguous “electronic transmissions,” while simultaneously invoking technological neutrality without addressing the economically decisive distinction between goods-like and services-like digital products. This omission has become untenable as artificial intelligence systems are traded both as remotely accessed services and as deployable, durable digital artifacts that function as capital goods. This duality is already reflected in export control regimes and corporate business models. Third, the EMPA remains largely silent on the valuation of data and the capture of data rents, despite the growing centrality of data as the primary input into AI systems and the significant distributional consequences for small open economies.  Canada has, in past negotiations, made concessions on data without evident attention to its value. The brief concludes that Canada should not treat the EMPA as a model for its own negotiations with Mercosur partners. Instead, it recommends that Canada anchor any digital trade chapter in the WTO JSI text, pursue WTO-plus provisions where feasible, and ensure that any agreed text preserves regulatory space to address AI classification, data sovereignty, and the metering and valuation of data in order to future-proof Canada’s digital trade policy.

AI.tldr: 该简报分析了加拿大在与南方共同市场贸易协定中应追求的数字经济目标，指出欧盟-南方共同市场伙伴关系协定(EMPA)的数字经济条款存在不足，建议加拿大不应以EMPA为模板，而应基于WTO电子商务联合声明倡议文本，并加入前瞻性条款以应对AI和数据经济挑战。
AI.research_question: 加拿大在与南方共同市场的贸易协定中应追求哪些数字经济措施目标？
AI.motivation: 随着多边贸易治理破裂，中小型开放经济体需要建立基于规则的贸易合作。EMPA虽然在这方面迈出了积极一步，但其数字经济条款相对于WTO电子商务联合声明倡议是"WTO减让"的，且未能充分适应机器知识资本时代的新现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 数字经济治理理论；2) 数字产品分类理论（商品型vs服务型）；3) 数据价值与租金捕获理论；4) 技术中立性原则的局限性；5) 机器知识资本时代的经济特征。
AI.method: 比较分析法：将EMPA的数字经济条款与WTO电子商务联合声明倡议文本进行比较分析，重点关注三个核心设计问题。
AI.findings: 1) EMPA的电子商务条款有限且碎片化，缺乏无纸贸易、数字支付等关键领域的法律框架；2) 协议延续了WTO将跨境数字流视为模糊"电子传输"的做法，未解决商品型与服务型数字产品的经济区分；3) 对数据价值和数据租金捕获问题保持沉默，忽视了数据作为AI系统主要输入的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了机器知识资本时代数字经济治理的新分析框架；2) 揭示了技术中立性原则在数字产品分类中的局限性；3) 强调了数据价值评估和租金捕获在数字贸易协定中的理论重要性；4) 为中小型开放经济体的数字贸易政策提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为加拿大与南方共同市场的谈判提供了具体政策建议；2) 建议以WTO JSI文本为基础，追求WTO-plus条款；3) 强调保留监管空间以应对AI分类、数据主权和数据计量估值问题；4) 提供了"未来验证"加拿大数字贸易政策的实用框架。

title: The Impact of State and Local Tax Deductions on Household Relocation Decisions: Evidence From the TCJA Law
affiliations: University of Southern California and University of Southern California - Lusk Center for Real Estate

detail.title: The Impact of State and Local Tax Deductions on Household Relocation Decisions: Evidence From the TCJA Law
detail.abstract: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA) had a major impact on the tax liability of highincome individuals in states with high state and local taxes. The impact arose from a newly instituted $10,000 cap on state and local tax deductions (SALT), meaning that itemizers with more than $10,000 of state and local taxes saw their effective tax liabilities rise by as much as 58 percent. If states were previously in a Tiebout equilibrium regarding local taxation and spatial allocation, this change in Federal tax policy would upset that equilibrium, inducing migration. Using a difference-indifferences framework and Internal Revenue Service data, we find that TCJA induced movement from high SALT states to low SALT states.

AI.tldr: TCJA对州和地方税抵扣设置1万美元上限，显著增加了高税州高收入人群的税负，打破了蒂伯特均衡，导致从高税州向低税州的迁移。
AI.research_question: 2017年减税与就业法案(TCJA)是否通过限制州和地方税抵扣，导致高税州居民向低税州迁移？
AI.motivation: TCJA对州和地方税抵扣设置1万美元上限，显著增加了高税州高收入人群的税负（最高可达58%），这可能打破了原有的蒂伯特均衡，引发人口迁移。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蒂伯特均衡理论：居民根据地方税收和公共服务质量选择居住地，形成空间配置均衡。联邦税收政策变化会打破这种均衡。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法，使用美国国税局数据，分析TCJA实施前后高税州和低税州的人口迁移模式。
AI.findings: TCJA确实导致了从高SALT州（高州和地方税州）向低SALT州的迁移，验证了税收政策变化对人口空间分布的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为蒂伯特均衡理论提供了实证支持，展示了联邦税收政策如何通过改变地方税收的相对价格来影响居民迁移决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于税收政策变化对人口流动影响的实证证据，有助于评估未来税收改革可能带来的空间经济影响。

title: The Effectiveness of Monetary Policy in Controlling Inflation in Angola: An Econometric Analysis Using Local Projections
affiliations: Universidade Católica de Angola - UCAN

detail.title: The Effectiveness of Monetary Policy in Controlling Inflation in Angola: An Econometric Analysis Using Local Projections

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research uses only publicly available secondary data and does not involve human subjects or personal data. As such, no ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study examines the effectiveness of monetary policy in controlling inflation in Angola, an economy highly exposed to oil-price volatility and exchange-rate shocks. Using monthly data from 2012-2025 and the Local Projections method, the paper evaluates how key policy instruments influence inflation dynamics. Results show that neither the BNA policy rate nor the marginal lending facility rate generates significant price adjustments, indicating weak interestrate transmission. Changes in reserve requirements produce only temporary effects, while broad money growth has no measurable impact. By contrast, exchange-rate shocks generate immediate and persistent pass-through to prices. Overall, Angola's inflation is mainly driven by external and structural forces, underscoring the need for stronger monetary transmission mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2012-2025年月度数据和局部投影法，分析安哥拉货币政策控制通胀的有效性。研究发现利率工具传导机制薄弱，准备金要求仅有暂时效果，广义货币增长无显著影响，而汇率冲击对价格有直接且持续的传递效应。
AI.research_question: 安哥拉货币政策在控制通胀方面的有效性如何？特别是在高度暴露于油价波动和汇率冲击的经济环境中，不同政策工具对通胀动态的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 安哥拉经济高度依赖石油出口，面临显著的油价波动和汇率冲击，这对其通胀控制提出了特殊挑战。理解货币政策在这种环境下的有效性，对于政策制定和宏观经济稳定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导机制理论，特别是利率渠道、信贷渠道和汇率渠道。研究检验在资源依赖型经济体中，传统货币政策工具的有效性，以及外部冲击对通胀动态的主导作用。
AI.method: 使用2012-2025年的月度数据，采用局部投影法（Local Projections method）评估关键政策工具对通胀动态的影响。
AI.findings: 1. BNA政策利率和边际贷款便利利率对价格调整无显著影响，表明利率传导机制薄弱；2. 准备金要求变化仅产生暂时性效果；3. 广义货币增长无显著影响；4. 汇率冲击对价格有直接且持续的传递效应；5. 安哥拉通胀主要由外部和结构性因素驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为资源依赖型经济体的货币政策有效性提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了在高度外部冲击环境下传统货币政策工具的局限性；3. 强调了汇率渠道在小型开放石油经济体中的主导作用；4. 丰富了关于货币政策传导机制异质性的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为安哥拉央行提供了货币政策工具有效性的实证依据；2. 建议加强货币政策传导机制建设；3. 强调需要关注外部冲击管理和结构性改革；4. 为类似资源依赖型经济体的政策制定提供参考。

title: Carbon Risk Exposure, Renewable Energy Consumption, and World Development Factors: Global Evidence from Broad-Based Financial Development

detail.title: Carbon Risk Exposure, Renewable Energy Consumption, and World Development Factors: Global Evidence from Broad-Based Financial Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am the principal head investigator in chief for this working paper, for which I have contributed to all parts of the manuscript thoroughly. I have all rights served for step-by-step replication packages for responsible science.
declarations.ethicsApproval: I am the principal head investigator in chief for this working paper, for which I have contributed to all the parts of the manuscript thoroughly. I have all rights served for step-by-step replication packages for responsible science.

detail.abstract: Employing novel panel data of 183 economies over the past decades, the study examines the roles of broad-based financial development in renewable energy-carbon nexuses. The study highlights the efficiency of financial institutions (FI), markets (FM), and overall financial development (OFD) contributing to sustainable economic growth through decarbonization and boosting renewable energy transition across the world's economies. The positive outcomes of the financial development pyramid for the world's sustainable development are conditional on a broad set of development indicators, demographics, and geography. Income inequality and uneven socioeconomic factors are important determinants of the environmental friendliness of financial development to the renewable energy-carbon nexus. Our findings offer crucial policy implications for regional economies toward sustainable development goals.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用183个经济体数十年的面板数据，分析广义金融发展在可再生能源-碳关联中的作用，发现金融机构、市场和整体金融发展通过脱碳和促进可再生能源转型推动可持续经济增长，但这些积极效果受到发展指标、人口统计和地理因素的制约。
AI.research_question: 广义金融发展如何影响可再生能源与碳排放之间的关系？金融发展的环境友好性受到哪些社会经济因素的制约？
AI.motivation: 理解金融发展在促进可再生能源转型和减少碳排放方面的作用，为各国实现可持续发展目标提供政策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融发展金字塔理论（金融机构、金融市场、整体金融发展），可持续发展理论，环境经济学中的脱碳理论。
AI.method: 使用183个经济体数十年的面板数据进行实证分析，考察金融发展对可再生能源-碳关联的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 金融机构、金融市场和整体金融发展通过脱碳和促进可再生能源转型推动可持续经济增长；2. 金融发展的积极效果受到发展指标、人口统计和地理因素的制约；3. 收入不平等和不平衡的社会经济因素是影响金融发展环境友好性的重要决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了金融发展理论在环境可持续性领域的应用；2. 提出了金融发展环境友好性的条件性框架；3. 深化了对金融发展-可再生能源-碳排放三元关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为区域经济体制定可持续发展政策提供依据；2. 强调需要针对不同社会经济条件制定差异化的金融发展策略；3. 指出减少收入不平等对提升金融发展环境效益的重要性。

title: The Randomness of Financial Markets
affiliations: Purdue University

detail.title: The Randomness of Financial Markets
detail.abstract: This paper characterizes a structural source of return unpredictability generated by selfreferential trading interactions. In a broad class of financial markets, returns decompose into a component measurable with respect to current information and a component arising from arbitrage-cycle trading activity that is orthogonal to all time-t information under a selfconsistent invariant regime. This orthogonality implies that a nontrivial portion of return variation cannot be anticipated from past or contemporaneous information. Under mild regularity, the cumulative effect of cycle innovations exhibits random-walk scaling and admits Lévy limits. These results provide a general description of price dynamics implied by endogenous interaction structure, without relying on informational efficiency, correct beliefs, or asset-specific assumptions.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现金融市场回报中存在一个结构性不可预测成分，源于自我参照的交易互动形成的套利循环交易活动，这部分回报与所有当前信息正交，无法通过过去或同期信息预测。
AI.research_question: 金融市场回报的不可预测性是否存在结构性来源？这种结构性来源是否源于自我参照的交易互动？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论通常将回报不可预测性归因于信息效率或随机冲击，但本文试图从市场内生互动结构的角度解释回报不可预测性的结构性来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自我参照交易互动的套利循环理论，不依赖信息效率、正确信念或资产特定假设的广义金融市场框架。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，在广泛的金融市场类别中分析回报分解，证明存在与所有时间t信息正交的套利循环交易成分，并分析其统计特性。
AI.findings: 1. 回报可分解为当前信息可测成分和套利循环交易活动产生的正交成分；2. 该正交成分意味着相当一部分回报变化无法从过去或同期信息预测；3. 在温和正则条件下，循环创新的累积效应呈现随机游走标度并允许Lévy极限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了不依赖信息效率、正确信念或资产特定假设的价格动态一般描述；2. 从内生互动结构角度解释了回报不可预测性的结构性来源；3. 建立了套利循环交易活动与回报正交性的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解市场效率的局限性提供了新视角；2. 对量化交易策略设计有启示意义；3. 为风险管理中考虑结构性不可预测成分提供了理论基础。

title: Home / ICWA Analysis Israel Recognises Somaliland: Causes and Consequences

detail.title: Home / ICWA Analysis Israel Recognises Somaliland: Causes and Consequences
detail.abstract: Israel became the first United Nations member state to officially recognise the Republic of Somaliland as an independent and sovereign state. The Israeli government declared that the "decision is in the spirit of the Abraham Accords." The government also invited the head of Somaliland, Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi to pay an official visit to Israel.

AI.tldr: 以色列成为首个正式承认索马里兰为独立主权国家的联合国成员国，此举基于《亚伯拉罕协议》精神，并邀请索马里兰领导人访以。
AI.research_question: 以色列承认索马里兰为独立主权国家的决定如何影响中东地区的地缘政治格局和国际关系？
AI.motivation: 以色列寻求在中东地区扩大外交影响力，通过《亚伯拉罕协议》框架下的外交突破，建立新的战略伙伴关系，并挑战现有的国际承认规范。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治理论、国际承认理论、外交政策分析、区域安全研究、国际法中的国家承认原则。
AI.method: 政策文件分析、历史比较分析、地缘政治风险评估、国际关系理论应用、案例研究方法。
AI.findings: 以色列的外交承认决定可能引发地区紧张局势，挑战索马里的领土完整主张，为其他寻求承认的分离实体树立先例，并可能影响非洲之角的地缘政治平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了国际承认理论在非传统外交关系中的应用，为分离主义实体的外交承认研究提供了新案例，深化了对《亚伯拉罕协议》框架下外交政策演变的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了处理类似外交承认案例的参考框架，帮助理解中东地区外交政策的战略转变，为国际组织应对此类外交挑战提供决策依据。

title: Anchoring Bias and Cross-Border Acquisition Premia
affiliations: University of Edinburgh and University of Edinburgh Business School

detail.title: Anchoring Bias and Cross-Border Acquisition Premia
detail.abstract: How do prior stock price peaks, as reference points, influence bid premia in cross-border M&A (CBA) compared to domestic deals? First, in CBA, relative to domestic M&A, offer prices are more likely to exceed past peaks, reducing deal withdrawal and speeding up completion. Second, peaks have stronger effect on bid premia in CBA, adding at least 1% on average. This effect is more pronounced when the bidder or target is from a developed market (outside the US), the bidder is listed, experienced, or the exchange rate is more volatile. However, this anchoring often leads to bidder overpayment and value destruction, despite simplifying valuation and negotiation.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在跨境并购中，目标公司历史股价峰值作为参考点，会显著提高并购溢价（至少增加1%），减少交易撤回并加速完成。但这种锚定效应常导致收购方支付过高价格并损害价值。
AI.research_question: 历史股价峰值作为参考点如何影响跨境并购（相比国内并购）的并购溢价？
AI.motivation: 理解跨境并购中行为金融因素（特别是锚定效应）对交易定价和结果的影响，以及这种影响与国内并购的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的锚定效应和参考点理论，特别是历史股价峰值作为心理参考点对并购定价决策的影响。
AI.method: 实证研究，通过比较跨境并购和国内并购的交易数据，分析历史股价峰值对并购溢价、交易完成率和完成时间的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 跨境并购中报价更可能超过历史峰值，减少交易撤回并加速完成；2. 峰值对并购溢价的影响在跨境并购中更强（平均至少增加1%）；3. 这种效应在发达市场（非美国）、上市收购方、经验丰富的收购方或汇率波动较大时更明显；4. 锚定效应常导致收购方支付过高价格并损害价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为金融学的锚定效应理论扩展到跨境并购领域，揭示了参考点在跨境交易中的特殊作用，丰富了跨境并购定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为并购参与者提供决策参考：收购方应注意锚定效应可能导致过高支付，目标方可利用参考点策略提高溢价，监管方需关注跨境并购中的价值转移问题。

title: Measuring Decent Work in India's Gig Economy
affiliations: RTM Nagpur University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Measuring Decent Work in India's Gig Economy
detail.abstract: NITI Aayog's report, titled 'India's Booming Gig and Platform Economy,' estimated that approximately 77 lakh workers were part of the gig economy in the fiscal year 2020-21, and is projected to increase to 2.35 crore by 2029-30. The technology-mediated platforms like Uber (in ridesharing), Swiggy (in food delivery), and Urban Company (in personal services) have made it easier for individuals to find such work to earn a living. ILO defines decent work as "productive work in which rights are protected, which generates an adequate income, with adequate social protection." However, the question remains how far these workers achieve 'decent work' standards? Using a sample of 370 location-based gig workers (including mobility, delivery and home service) in Nagpur, a prominent city of Maharashtra, Decent Work Index was designed and calculated. This index comprises of five dimensions-income security, social security, job security, work security, skill and representation. The findings show that the workers fall into moderate decent work category and sectoral disparities exist with mobility workers having the lowest score among the groups. Three distinct worker profiles emerged from this analysis: one which faced precarious work conditions; second which benefited from moderate security; and a third cluster which earned more but often logged in extra-long hours without proper rest or protection. Most workers fall into the first and third categories, showing that secure and fair work is not yet common in the gig economy. The findings reinforce that while the gig economy offers a basic safety net in terms of employment and income, it falls short on other essential components of decent work, particularly in terms of social protections, and opportunities for growth.

AI.tldr: 印度零工经济快速增长，但零工工人的体面工作水平仅为中等，存在部门差异，大多数工人面临不稳定的工作条件或过度工作缺乏保护。
AI.research_question: 印度零工经济中的工人在多大程度上实现了"体面工作"标准？
AI.motivation: 印度零工经济快速增长（预计从2020-21年的770万增加到2029-30年的2350万），但国际劳工组织定义的体面工作标准（包括权利保护、足够收入、社会保障）是否在这些平台工人中得到实现尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际劳工组织的体面工作概念框架，构建包含五个维度的体面工作指数：收入安全、社会保障、工作安全、技能和代表权。
AI.method: 对印度马哈拉施特拉邦那格浦尔市的370名基于位置的零工工人（包括出行、配送和家庭服务）进行抽样调查，设计并计算体面工作指数。
AI.findings: 1. 工人整体处于中等体面工作水平；2. 存在部门差异，出行工人的得分最低；3. 识别出三种工人类型：面临不稳定工作条件的工人、享有中等安全保障的工人、收入较高但工作时间过长且缺乏适当休息和保护的工人；4. 大多数工人属于第一和第三类，表明安全和公平工作在零工经济中并不常见。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了适用于零工经济的体面工作指数测量工具；2. 验证了国际劳工组织体面工作框架在平台经济中的适用性；3. 揭示了零工经济中体面工作的多维性和复杂性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了改善零工工人工作条件的实证依据；2. 指出了需要特别关注的领域：社会保障、成长机会、工作时间管理；3. 为平台公司设计更公平的工作安排提供了参考；4. 强调了部门差异，建议针对不同零工领域制定差异化政策。

title: Credit Access and Geographic Mobility *
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and University of Illinois Urbana Champaign

detail.title: Credit Access and Geographic Mobility *
detail.abstract: We investigate how increases in credit access impact residential mobility. Using a regression discontinuity design leveraging a cutoff commonly used in determining mortgage loan eligibility, we find that individuals who cross the cutoff from below are 13.4% more likely to move than their counterparts who remain below the cutoff. Threshold crossing also increases flows into homeownership and improves other non-mortgage credit outcomes. We find younger individuals (ages 25-29) 5.7pp less likely to move than average prime-age individuals despite experiencing 17.9% larger annual earnings gains, suggesting credit access alone is insufficient without addressing barriers specific to young movers.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现信贷获取增加会提升居民流动性，但年轻群体面临额外障碍
AI.research_question: 信贷获取增加如何影响居民流动性？
AI.motivation: 理解信贷市场对居民迁移决策的影响，特别是对年轻群体流动性的障碍
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷约束理论、居民迁移决策理论、生命周期理论
AI.method: 断点回归设计，利用抵押贷款资格评分的临界点进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 跨越临界点的个体迁移可能性增加13.4%；2. 促进住房自有率；3. 改善非抵押信贷结果；4. 年轻群体（25-29岁）迁移可能性比平均减少5.7个百分点，尽管收入增长更高
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信贷获取对居民流动性的影响机制，识别了年轻群体面临的特殊障碍
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改善居民流动性的政策建议，特别是针对年轻群体的信贷和迁移障碍

title: Comparative Econometric Analysis of a Novel Behavioral Indicator: GSSI
affiliations: Delhi Public School, Noida

detail.title: Comparative Econometric Analysis of a Novel Behavioral Indicator: GSSI
detail.abstract: This research paper constructs and tests a novel, high-frequency "revealed-preference" indicator for macroeconomic forecasting: the Global Sports Sentiment Index (GSSI). The GSSI is a new indicator we construct as a ratio of public search interest (sourced from Google Trends) in a "basket" of high-cost Luxury Sports (LX: 'F1', 'Golf', 'Tennis') versus a basket of low-cost Mass-Market Sports (MX: 'Football', 'Baseball', 'Basketball'). We propose a testable behavioral framework where shifts in the real economy are reflected in the public's collective search interest. We test two competing hypotheses: an "Aspiration Effect" (public interest shifts towards luxury topics in a downturn) and a "Substitution Effect" (public interest shifts away from them). We test this empirically, constructing two region-specific (US and India) quarterly datasets from 2004-2024. Our central finding is that the GSSI is a statistically significant predictor of US GDP growth (Granger p-value = 0.024). This effect is not present in India (p=0.503). We conclude that the GSSI, as a measure of relative public interest, is a valid, novel, and quantifiable forecasting tool for the US real economy, though its efficacy is limited by market fragmentation in developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于谷歌搜索数据的高频宏观经济预测指标GSSI，通过比较奢侈品运动与大众运动的搜索兴趣比率来预测美国GDP增长，但在印度市场效果不显著。
AI.research_question: 基于公众搜索兴趣构建的全球体育情绪指数(GSSI)能否有效预测宏观经济指标？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济指标存在滞后性，需要开发高频、实时的预测工具；公众搜索行为可能反映经济状况变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学框架：测试"抱负效应"（经济下行时公众对奢侈品兴趣增加）与"替代效应"（经济下行时公众对奢侈品兴趣减少）的竞争性假设。
AI.method: 构建GSSI指标（奢侈品运动搜索量/大众运动搜索量），使用2004-2024年美国与印度季度数据，进行格兰杰因果检验。
AI.findings: GSSI对美国GDP增长具有显著预测能力（p=0.024），但对印度GDP无预测能力（p=0.503），表明该指标在发达经济体有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于搜索数据的"显示偏好"宏观经济预测框架；验证了"抱负效应"在美国经济中的存在。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了新的高频经济预测工具；揭示了市场结构对行为指标有效性的影响。

title: Externalities in Sender-Receiver Stopping Games with Multiple Senders
affiliations: Ashoka University, Maastricht University and Maastricht University

detail.title: Externalities in Sender-Receiver Stopping Games with Multiple Senders

publicationDetails.detailsText: []

detail.abstract: We consider a dynamic model of sender-receiver stopping games with multiple senders and only one receiver. The state of the world follows an iid--process throughout the game. At each period, each sender observes the current state and sends a message to the receiver, suggesting either to stop or to continue. The receiver, only seeing the collections of messages but not the state, decides either to stop the game, or to continue which takes the game to the next period. The payoff to each player is a function of the state when the receiver quits, with higher states leading to better payoffs, and it can be discounted or undiscounted. We introduce a focal strategy profile for these games, called the regular strategy profile, in which each sender reports sincerely, and the receiver stops if the number of stop messages exceeds a threshold. We prove that the regular strategy profile is a Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium (PBE) if the players are sufficiently patient.With this PBE as a focal equilibrium, we study the externalities that an additional sender may impose on the existing senders as well as the receiver.Perhaps surprisingly, an additional sender can have positive externality on the existing senders, and can also have negative externality on the receiver.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多发送者单接收者的动态停止博弈，提出"常规策略"作为焦点均衡，分析额外发送者对现有参与者的外部性影响。
AI.research_question: 在多发送者单接收者的动态停止博弈中，额外发送者如何影响现有发送者和接收者的福利？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中存在许多多专家建议单决策者的情境（如医疗诊断、投资决策），需要理解额外信息提供者对现有参与者的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态博弈理论、贝叶斯均衡、发送者-接收者模型、外部性理论
AI.method: 理论建模与证明：构建动态停止博弈模型，定义常规策略，证明其作为完美贝叶斯均衡的条件，分析外部性效应。
AI.findings: 1. 常规策略（发送者诚实报告，接收者基于阈值停止）在参与者足够耐心时构成完美贝叶斯均衡；2. 额外发送者可能对现有发送者产生正外部性；3. 额外发送者可能对接收者产生负外部性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为多发送者动态停止博弈提供了焦点均衡概念；2. 揭示了信息聚合博弈中外部性的非直观特性；3. 扩展了发送者-接收者模型的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为多专家咨询情境提供决策参考；2. 帮助理解信息市场中的参与者激励；3. 为组织设计信息收集机制提供洞见。

title: Judgment Cannot Be Outsourced: Phronesis, Scale, and the Limits of Modern Institutions
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

detail.title: Judgment Cannot Be Outsourced: Phronesis, Scale, and the Limits of Modern Institutions
detail.abstract: This article discusses not the failure of a specific institution or case, but a structural problem that has become common in the digital age: how practical reason (phronesis) is gradually squeezed out, delayed, or even outsourced within institutions as their scale expands, operating tempo accelerates, and compliance and processes become highly formalized. The article points out that the core risk of modern institutions lies not in the loss of values or technological inadequacy, but in a hidden yet systemic misalignment—judgment is mistakenly treated as something that can be replaced by processes, compliance language, or algorithms. Under this misalignment, institutions gradually lose their ability to instantly perceive facts, learn from anomalies, and roll back their own errors. Institutions appear to run smoothly but unknowingly cross the red line from ’rollback-capable failure’ to ’irreversible phase transition’. Through a systematic analysis of mechanisms such as the weaponization of compliance language, KPI perverse incentives, uncontrolled module coupling, nonlinear amplification of fear, and the collapse of the fact layer, this article proposes a key criterion: when compliance language gains veto power over facts, the institution undergoes a qualitative change. Under conditions where digital propagation speed significantly outpaces traditional corrective mechanisms, once this phase transition spills over, institutions will rapidly fall into a narrative blue-screen, with fact sovereignty outsourced to emotions, algorithms, and certainty narratives. The article further argues that the root of institutional problems is not a lack of ’reason,’ but rather operating on an outdated time model. The governance logic of the 20th century, predicated on delayed correction, becomes a risk amplifier in the high-speed propagation environment of the 21st century. Therefore, this article shifts the key to institutional upgrading from ’smarter technology’ to the ’re-embedding of practical reason,’ advocating for a clear distinction between the grammar of judgment and digital algorithms. In the conclusion, the article proposes the direction of ’practical-reason-embedded institutions’: utilizing digital technology as a front-end interface for facts, a tool for tempo-layering governance, and an auditable memory and rollback system, rather than as a the locus of judgment. This allows facts to continuously enter the institution without disintegration, judgment to bear responsibility, and retains the structural capacity to be interrupted and corrected by reality. The maturity of an institution lies not in a perfect closed loop, but in always retaining a rollback-capable interface.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字时代机构面临的结构性问题：随着规模扩大、运营节奏加快、合规流程高度形式化，实践理性（phronesis）被逐渐挤压、延迟甚至外包。核心风险在于判断被误认为可由流程、合规语言或算法替代，导致机构失去即时感知事实、从异常中学习、回滚错误的能力，最终从"可回滚失败"滑向"不可逆相变"。文章提出机构升级的关键不是"更智能的技术"，而是"实践理性的再嵌入"。
AI.research_question: 在数字时代，随着机构规模扩大、运营节奏加快、合规流程高度形式化，实践理性（phronesis）如何被挤压、延迟或外包？这种结构性错位如何导致机构从"可回滚失败"滑向"不可逆相变"？
AI.motivation: 现代机构面临的核心风险不是价值丧失或技术不足，而是一种隐蔽但系统性的错位：判断被误认为可由流程、合规语言或算法替代。这种错位导致机构逐渐失去即时感知事实、从异常中学习、回滚错误的能力，最终在数字传播速度远超传统纠正机制的环境下，机构可能迅速陷入"叙事蓝屏"。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 实践理性（phronesis）理论
2. 机构失败理论（可回滚失败 vs 不可逆相变）
3. 合规语言武器化理论
4. 时间模型理论（20世纪延迟纠正 vs 21世纪高速传播环境）
5. 事实主权理论
AI.method: 系统性机制分析，包括：合规语言武器化、KPI逆向激励、模块耦合失控、恐惧非线性放大、事实层崩溃等机制的分析。提出关键判断标准：当合规语言获得对事实的否决权时，机构发生质变。
AI.findings:
1. 现代机构的核心风险是判断被流程、合规语言或算法替代的系统性错位
2. 当合规语言获得对事实的否决权时，机构发生质变
3. 在数字传播速度远超传统纠正机制的环境下，机构可能迅速陷入"叙事蓝屏"
4. 机构问题的根源不是缺乏"理性"，而是基于过时的时间模型运作
5. 20世纪的延迟纠正治理逻辑在21世纪高速传播环境中成为风险放大器
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"实践理性被挤压"作为数字时代机构结构性问题的新理论框架
2. 建立"可回滚失败"到"不可逆相变"的机构失败连续体理论
3. 发展合规语言武器化与事实主权外包的理论模型
4. 提出时间模型错位作为机构问题的根源理论
5. 构建"实践理性嵌入机构"的新理论方向
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为机构提供关键预警标准：当合规语言获得对事实的否决权时需警惕
2. 提出机构升级方向：从"更智能技术"转向"实践理性再嵌入"
3. 建议明确区分判断语法与数字算法
4. 提出数字技术应作为事实前端接口、节奏分层治理工具、可审计记忆和回滚系统
5. 倡导机构保留可回滚接口的结构能力，而非追求完美闭环

title: Evaluating Creative Work with Artificial Intelligence: Evidence from Constrained Innovation Tasks
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome, Sapienza University of Rome, Sapienza University of Rome, Department of Economics and Law, Sapienza University of Rome and Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: Evaluating Creative Work with Artificial Intelligence: Evidence from Constrained Innovation Tasks
detail.abstract: We study whether a large language model can reliably evaluate human creativity in constrained, innovation-like tasks. Using expert-generated creative outputs from a validated experiment with workers in cultural and creative industries, we embed ChatGPT as an evaluator and benchmark its assessments against expert human judgments obtained through the Consensual Assessment Technique. In Study 1, we show that AI-based creativity evaluations exhibit internal consistency comparable to that of expert judges across repeated and independent runs, even under conservative scenarios. Replacing a human judge with an AI evaluator does not reduce inter-rater reliability across drawing, mathematical, and verbal tasks. In Study 2, we find that AI evaluations are systematically structured along fluency, flexibility, originality, and elaboration, with task-specific weighting of these dimensions. Overall, the results indicate that AI can serve as a reliable and structured evaluator of creativity in constrained innovation environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大型语言模型（如ChatGPT）能否在约束性创新任务中可靠评估人类创造力。通过将AI评估与专家人类评估（采用共识评估技术）进行对比，研究发现AI评估具有与人类专家相当的内部一致性，且能系统性地基于流畅性、灵活性、原创性和精细性四个维度进行结构化评估。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型能否在约束性创新任务中可靠地评估人类创造力？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在创意领域的应用日益广泛，需要验证AI是否能够可靠地评估人类创造力，特别是在创新任务中，这有助于降低评估成本、提高评估效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于共识评估技术（Consensual Assessment Technique）的理论框架，该技术认为专家对创意作品的评估是有效的。同时借鉴创造力评估的四个维度：流畅性、灵活性、原创性和精细性。
AI.method: 采用两个研究设计：研究1将ChatGPT作为评估者，将其评估结果与来自文化创意产业专家的共识评估进行对比，分析内部一致性和评分者间信度；研究2分析AI评估在四个创造力维度上的结构化特征。
AI.findings: 1. AI评估的内部一致性与人类专家相当；2. 用AI替代人类评估者不会降低评分者间信度；3. AI评估能系统性地基于流畅性、灵活性、原创性和精细性四个维度进行结构化评估，且不同任务中这些维度的权重不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了AI在创造力评估中的可靠性；2. 揭示了AI评估的结构化特征；3. 扩展了共识评估技术在AI环境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为创意产业提供低成本、高效率的创造力评估工具；2. 为教育、企业创新等领域提供AI辅助评估方案；3. 为AI在创意评估中的应用提供实证支持。

title: When the Spare Tyre Goes Flat: Monetary Policy Transmission through Non-Banks
affiliations: and

detail.title: When the Spare Tyre Goes Flat: Monetary Policy Transmission through Non-Banks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 2

detail.abstract: ChaMP). It consists of economists from the European Central Bank (ECB) and the national central banks (NCBs) of the European System of Central Banks (ESCB). ChaMP is coordinated by a team chaired by Philipp Hartmann (ECB), and consisting of Diana Bonfim (Banco de Portugal), Margherita Bottero (Banca d'Italia), Emmanuel Dhyne (Nationale Bank van België/Banque Nationale de Belgique) and Maria T.
